definition_zh: 一起；共同；合起来；连续地；（get together）聚会
definition_en: with another person or thing, in one place or as one group; also in an unbroken sequence
core_image: 两双手伸到一处，掌与掌合拢成一点
scene: 晚饭前，桌上的碗筷被一只只摆好，孩子在旁边帮忙。 The family put the table together before dinner.
sceneCN: 这里 together 是「一起、共同」（第 1 个义项：与他人或他物相聚一处）；句意为一家人在晚饭前一起把桌子拼好。画面有桌面、碗筷与帮忙的孩子。

pos.zh: 副词：一起；共同；合起来；连续地

derivatives.zh: 加 -ness 构成，义为「亲密；团结」
加前缀 al- 变体构成，义为「完全；总共」
复合词，义为「聚会」

senses.title: With one another
senses.definition: with another person or group, in each other's company
senses.definitionCN: 与他人或群体在一处、同在一行
senses.example: They worked together all afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 他们整个下午一起工作。
senses.why: Old English togædere was a phrase meaning to and in a gathering, that is, into one place.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 togædere 意为「聚到一处」，即合成一个地方。

senses.title: In one place or whole
senses.definition: so as to form one group, set, or whole
senses.definitionCN: 聚成一群、一套或一个整体
senses.example: She tied the branches together.
senses.exampleCN: 她把树枝捆在一起。
senses.why: The gathering sense becomes the act of joining parts into a unit.
senses.whyCN: 「聚拢」义延伸为把部分合成整体。

senses.title: In cooperation
senses.definition: in shared effort toward a common aim
senses.definitionCN: 为共同目标协作
senses.example: The whole street pulled together during the flood.
senses.exampleCN: 洪水期间整条街的人齐心协力。
senses.why: People who are physically gathered can act as one, and the word marks that shared effort.
senses.whyCN: 身体聚在一处的人可以一起行动，本词便标示这种共同用力。

senses.title: In continuous succession
senses.definition: used with plural time words for an unbroken run
senses.definitionCN: 与表示时段的复数连用，指不间断的一段
senses.example: It rained for three days together.
senses.exampleCN: 雨连续下了三天。
senses.why: Things placed one after another without a gap are together in a row as well as in space.
senses.whyCN: 彼此紧挨、无缝排列的东西，在时间上也是连着的一串。

senses.title: To assemble
senses.definition: used with put to make or assemble something from parts
senses.definitionCN: 与 put 连用，指由零件组成
senses.example: He put the shelf together in an hour.
senses.exampleCN: 他一小时就把架子组装好了。
senses.why: Assembling is the literal gathering of parts into one object.
senses.whyCN: 组装就是把零件真正聚成一个物件。

senses.title: In company with
senses.definition: used in together with to add something to what is already stated
senses.definitionCN: 用于 together with，把某物加上去
senses.example: The rent, together with heating, comes to a thousand.
senses.exampleCN: 房租加取暖费一共一千。
senses.why: Adding to a group is gathering the new item into the existing set.
senses.whyCN: 加入群体就是把新项聚进已有的集合。

senses.title: In harmony
senses.definition: in agreement or well matched
senses.definitionCN: 和谐、相配、一致
senses.example: The colours in the room go together well.
senses.exampleCN: 房间里的颜色很协调。
senses.why: Two things that fit join without a seam, which is gathering without friction.
senses.whyCN: 相配的两物无缝相接，正是无摩擦的聚合。

senses.title: The act of meeting
senses.definition: used in get-together for a social meeting
senses.definitionCN: 用于 get-together，指社交聚会
senses.example: A small get-together was held after the ceremony.
senses.exampleCN: 典礼后举行了一场小型聚会。
senses.why: The adverb becomes a noun in the compound, naming the meeting it describes.
senses.whyCN: 副词在复合词中变作名词，命名其所描述的会面。

intro.en: Old English had togædere, built from to and a form of gathering, so the original picture is movement into one place.
intro.cn: 古英语已有 togædere，由 to 与表示聚集的成分构成，原图景是「聚到一处」。

items.en: Togædere meant into one place, in a body.
items.cn: togædere 意为聚到一处、在一体之中。

items.en: The second element is related to gathering, giving the whole word a pull inward.
items.cn: 第二成分与「聚集」相关，使整词带有向内收拢的意思。

items.en: The form settles toward together, dropping the older ending.
items.cn: 形式趋于 together，古旧词尾脱落。

items.en: The word extends from place to shared action.
items.cn: 本词从地点扩展到共同行动。

items.en: The phrase for days together develops for continuous periods.
items.cn: for days together 这样的短语发展出「连续时段」义。

items.en: Togetherness appears as a noun for the feeling of closeness.
items.cn: togetherness 作为名词出现，指亲密之感。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers its derived and near forms, and the near-meaning group lists other words for joint action.
note.cn: 形近组收集派生与相近形式，近义组列出表示共同行动的其他词。

entries.definitionCN: 分开地

entries.definitionCN: 分别地

normal.en: Together is to plus gather, the two halves of pulling things in.
normal.cn: together 是 to 加 gather，两半合起来就是向内收拢。

normal.en: Get together, pull together, put together all add a verb of motion.
normal.cn: get together、pull together、put together 都叠加了动作动词。

normal.en: Together with adds an item; altogether means completely.
normal.cn: together with 是加上一项，altogether 是完全、总共。

normal.en: For days together marks an unbroken run of time.
normal.cn: for days together 标记连续不断的一段时间。

abstract.cn: 想象两只手在一点上合拢。

abstract.en: Think of two branches bound with one cord.
abstract.cn: 想两根树枝被一根绳捆在一起。

abstract.en: A whole street pulling a rope is the word in action.
abstract.cn: 整条街的人拉一根绳，就是这个词的具体画面。

examples.en: We studied together in the library.
examples.cn: 我们一起在图书馆学习。

examples.en: He tied the papers together with string.
examples.cn: 他用绳子把文件捆在一起。

examples.en: The rain lasted for two weeks together.
examples.cn: 雨连续下了两个星期。

sensesIntro.en: One pull into a single place explains company, combination, cooperation, unbroken runs, assembly, added items, harmony, and the noun for a meeting.
sensesIntro.cn: 「聚到一处」这一拉力解释了同在、合成、协作、连续、组装、附加、协调，以及表示聚会的名词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hands meeting and closing round the same object.
core.cn: 核心意象：两只手伸来，合握住同一件东西。

branches.en: Being in each other's company.
Joining parts and assembling them.
branches.cn: 把部分连成一体并组装。

branches.en: Shared effort, addition, and harmony.

intro.en: The word is a native compound of two old elements, and its endings form the noun and the common negative-and-total alt- form.
intro.cn: 这个词是两个古老本土成分的复合，其词尾构出名词与常见的 alt- 形式。

latinIntro.en: No Latin lies behind together; the Latin list gives comparison words for joint and separate.

definition_zh: 戏剧；剧本；戏剧性事件；激动
definition_en: a serious play for the theatre, or an exciting event full of feeling
core_image: 幕布拉开，灯光打在舞台中央
scene: 学校礼堂里，幕布缓缓升起，台下鸦雀无声。 The school drama drew a full house on Friday.
sceneCN: 这里 drama 是「戏剧」（第 1 个义项：在舞台上演出的剧）；句意：学校的这出戏周五场场满座。

dramatic 加副词后缀构成，义为「戏剧性地；急剧地」

senses.title: A play for the stage
senses.definition: a serious play written to be performed
senses.definitionCN: 为演出而写的严肃剧目
senses.example: The drama tells of a fisherman and the sea.
senses.exampleCN: 这部戏讲的是一个渔夫与大海的故事。
senses.why: Greek dran means to do: a drama is a story done, acted out before your eyes.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 dran 意为「做」：drama 就是「被做出来」的故事，当着观众演出来。

senses.title: An exciting real-life event
senses.definition: an exciting or emotional real event
senses.definitionCN: 扣人心弦的真实事件
senses.example: The rescue was full of drama.
senses.exampleCN: 这场营救充满戏剧性。
senses.why: Real life begins to look like a staged play: tension, turns and a climax.
senses.whyCN: 现实生活开始像一出戏：有张力、有转折、有高潮。

senses.title: Exaggerated excitement
senses.definition: too much emotion about a small matter
senses.definitionCN: 对小事反应过度
senses.example: Do not make a drama out of a lost pencil.
senses.exampleCN: 别为丢一支铅笔大惊小怪。
senses.why: Stage emotion spills onto small events: everything is performed too loudly.
senses.whyCN: 舞台情绪泼洒到小事上：一切都演得太夸张。

definition_en: a belief, custom, or way of doing something that has been passed down from one generation to the next
core_image: 一只手把一件老器物递给下一代的手
scene: 除夕夜老人把祖传的木勺交给孩子，让他搅第一下锅里的汤。 The family keeps the tradition of cooking the same soup every winter night.
sceneCN: 这里 tradition 是「传统」（第 1 个义项：世代相传的习俗或做法）；句意为这家人保留着每个冬夜煮同样一锅汤的传统。

derivatives.zh: 由名词加 -al 构成形容词，义为「传统的」
由形容词加 -ly 构成，义为「按照传统地」
由形容词加 -ism 构成，义为「传统主义」

senses.title: A custom handed down through generations
senses.definition: a habit or belief that has been passed from older people to younger ones over many years
senses.definitionCN: 由年长者传给年轻一代、延续多年的习惯或信念
senses.example: The tradition of singing at harvest has lasted four centuries.
senses.exampleCN: 丰收时节唱歌的传统已延续了四百年。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to hand over, so a tradition is literally a thing handed from hand to hand.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「交出、交付」，所以传统就是一手一手传下来的东西。

senses.title: The body of such customs as a whole
senses.definition: all the customs and beliefs of a people or group considered together
senses.definitionCN: 一个民族或群体的全部习俗与信念的总和
senses.example: He knows the oral tradition of the mountain villages well.
senses.exampleCN: 他对山村的民间传统非常熟悉。
senses.why: Many handings-down pile up into a store, and that store is called the tradition of a people.
senses.whyCN: 许多次传递堆成一个库，这个库就被称为一个民族的传统。

senses.title: A way of working in an art or craft
senses.definition: an established style or method passed on within an art, science, or craft
senses.definitionCN: 在某门艺术、学问或手艺内部沿袭下来的既定风格或方法
senses.example: The painter works in the tradition of the northern landscape schools.
senses.exampleCN: 这位画家属于北方山水流派一脉。
senses.why: Skills are handed down like objects, so a school of art becomes a tradition carried by masters and pupils.
senses.whyCN: 技艺像器物一样被递下去，于是一个艺术流派就成了由师承承担的传统。

senses.title: The act of handing something over
senses.definition: the formal act of passing something into another person's keeping
senses.definitionCN: 把某物正式交到他人手里的行为
senses.example: The tradition of the keys to the new mayor takes place at noon.
senses.exampleCN: 把钥匙交给新市长的仪式在正午举行。
senses.why: This is the oldest legal sense, still visible in the English verb hand over.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的法律含义，在英语 hand over 这一说法里仍能看见。

senses.title: A long-held custom in an institution
senses.definition: an established practice in a school, office, or team that everyone follows
senses.definitionCN: 学校、机关或团队里人人遵循的既定做法
senses.example: It is a tradition here that the newest member makes the tea.
senses.exampleCN: 这里有个惯例：最新来的成员负责泡茶。
senses.why: Small groups create their own handings-down, and the word serves for these everyday customs too.
senses.whyCN: 小群体也会形成自己的传递，这个词同样用于这些日常惯例。

intro.en: Tradition comes from Latin traditio, a handing over, from tradere, to hand across, made of trans-, across, and dare, to give.
intro.cn: tradition 来自拉丁语 traditio（交付），源自 tradere（交过去），由 trans-（穿过）与 dare（给）构成。

items.en: Tradere is built from trans-, across, and dare, to give, and means to hand over or deliver.
items.cn: tradere 由 trans-（穿过）与 dare（给）合成，意为交出、交付。

items.en: Traditio names the act of delivery and, in law, the transfer of property into another's hands.
items.cn: traditio 指交付行为，在法律上指把财产转移到他方手中。

items.en: Old French tradition keeps the sense of handing down teaching and custom.
items.cn: 古法语 tradition 保留了传授教义与习俗的含义。

items.en: English uses tradition first in religious writing for teaching received from the fathers of the church.
items.cn: 英语最先在宗教文献中使用 tradition，指从教父那里接受的教导。

items.en: From the seventeenth century the word widens to any custom or practice inherited from the past.
items.cn: 十七世纪起，这个词扩展到任何从过去继承下来的习俗或做法。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words from the same giving stem, while the near-meaning group gathers customs and inherited practice.
note.cn: 形近组收集同一「给」词根的词，近义组收集习俗与沿袭的做法。

entries.definition: following old customs
entries.definitionCN: 传统的

entries.definition: in the old customary way
entries.definitionCN: 按照传统地

entries.definition: one who hands over his own side
entries.definitionCN: 叛徒；卖国者

entries.definition: to hand someone over to an enemy
entries.definitionCN: 背叛；出卖

entries.definition: a usual way of behaving in a group
entries.definitionCN: 习俗；习惯

entries.definition: the things and ways inherited from the past
entries.definitionCN: 遗产；传承

entries.definition: an accepted way of doing things
entries.definitionCN: 惯例；常规

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the giving root, from the family of -al, -ly, and -ism, and from the picture of a handover.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从「给」的词根、由 -al、-ly、-ism 构成的词族以及「递交」的画面入手。

normal.en: Trans- plus dare: give across. A tradition is what gets given across the years.
normal.cn: trans- 加 dare，就是「给过去」。传统就是被给过岁月的那些东西。

normal.en: The same root gives traitor and betray, because to hand someone over is also to betray.
normal.cn: 同一词根给出 traitor 与 betray，因为把人交出去也就是出卖。

normal.en: Traditional adds -al, traditionally adds -ly, traditionalism adds -ism.
normal.cn: traditional 加 -al，traditionally 加 -ly，traditionalism 加 -ism。

normal.en: Break with tradition and keep the tradition are opposites in one phrase family.
normal.cn: break with tradition 与 keep the tradition 是同一搭配族里的对立面。

normal.en: The word ends in -tion, so it names the thing and the act of handing down at once.
normal.cn: 本词以 -tion 结尾，同时指被传下来的东西与传递这一行为。

abstract.en: Picture an old wooden spoon passed from a grandmother's hand to a grandchild's.
abstract.cn: 想象一把旧木勺从祖母的手递到孙辈的手里。

abstract.en: Think of a path worn by many feet over centuries, still visible under fresh grass.
abstract.cn: 想一条被几百年脚步踩出的路，如今仍在新草下隐约可见。

abstract.en: A tradition is a choice that has already been made many times before you make it.
abstract.cn: 传统是一个在你做出之前就已经被做过许多次的选择。

examples.en: It is a tradition to eat dumplings on New Year's Eve.
examples.cn: 除夕吃饺子是一项传统。

examples.en: The village has kept its fishing traditions for many centuries.
examples.cn: 这个村子把捕鱼传统保留了许多个世纪。

examples.en: By tradition the eldest son lights the first lamp.
examples.cn: 按照传统，由长子点亮第一盏灯。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「穿递什」——一代人穿过时间把手里的东西递交给下一代。

root: 拉丁语 trans-（穿过）+ dare（给）→ tradere（交付）→ traditio（交付、传交）→ 古法语 tradition → 英语 tradition。同源词有 traitor、betray、tradition（教义传承义）。

sensesIntro.en: The root means a handover, so the entry begins with the custom handed down, gathers such handovers into a people's whole store, narrows to the school of an art, returns to the bare legal handover, and ends with the small customs of an institution.
sensesIntro.cn: 词根意为「递交」，因此本词先指被递下来的习俗，再把递交聚成一个民族的全部家底，收窄为艺术流派，回到纯粹的法律交付，最后落在团体内部的小惯例。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thing passed from an older hand into a younger one.
core.cn: 核心意象：一件东西从年长的手递进年轻的手。

branches.en: The single custom handed down.
All such customs together.
A tradition inside an art or craft.
branches.cn: 艺术或手艺内部的传承体系。

branches.en: The bare act of delivery in law.
branches.cn: 法律上纯粹的交付行为。

branches.en: The small habit of a group.

intro.en: The word rests on the Latin verb dare, to give, with the prefix trans- and the noun ending -tio; English adds -al, -ly, and -ism.
intro.cn: 本词建立在拉丁语动词 dare（给）之上，配前缀 trans- 与名词词尾 -tio；英语再加 -al、-ly、-ism。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries below show the giving verb and the handing-over noun behind this word.
latinIntro.cn: 下面的拉丁词条给出本词背后的「给」动词与「交付」名词。

items.example: Dare is the core verb of the family.
items.exampleCN: dare 是这个词族的核心动词。

items.example: Trans- turns giving into giving across.
Tradition is the handing down and what is handed down.
items.exampleCN: tradition 既是传递行为也是传递之物。
traditional 意为与传统相关的。

items.example: Traitor keeps the older sense of handing over.
items.exampleCN: traitor 保留了「交出」的旧义。
